narration:0:1510528001:0.text: As you lie down to sleep, you ponder the clues about Gorgonna, slowly drifting off...
narration:0:1510528001:0.source_cn: 躺在精心准备的床铺上，你回想着有关露的线索，逐渐陷入沉眠……
narration:0:1510528001:0.male: As you lie down to sleep, you ponder the clues about Gorgonna, slowly drifting off...
narration:0:1510528001:0.female: As you lie down to sleep, you ponder the clues about Gorgonna, slowly drifting off...

narration:1:1510528002:0.text: But when you wake up, Gala is nowhere to be found.
narration:1:1510528002:0.source_cn: 然而，一觉醒来，身边的加拉却不见了
